_readme:
Load-bearing figures for portuguese-estate.com. A figure phrase carried by five or more articles is a claim about the world and must be registered here with a source and a date; a figure used once is a local worked example and needs no entry. Entries are grouped by figure because one number means several things: 24 months is both the DL 97/2026 destination condition and the IMT-refund residency window, and both meanings are registered separately. Adding an entry is a claim, so the scorer reports every entry a change introduces and a reviewer sees them.

DELIBERATELY PARTIAL. The corpus carries 204 figures in eight or more files. Registered here are only those whose primary source can be named exactly. The bare ratios the corpus leans on most - 10%, 5%, 30%, 3% - are NOT registered and should not be: 10% is the CPCV deposit convention on some pages, a management fee on others and a rent-cap arithmetic step on others again, so a single entry would hand unrelated pages a provenance they have not earned. Those pages need rewriting so the figure carries its meaning, not a registry entry. The registry gate arms itself at 80% coverage of load-bearing figures, so this file is meant to grow with the rewrite waves rather than be filled in one pass.
